result.topic_en: Derivation of the general term of Lagrange's series: expressing the n-th derivative of ψx with respect to u in terms of derivatives with respect to t, and evaluating it at x = t.
result.transcription:
Man sucht nun $\psi x$
Es sei zuerst $fx = \psi x$ so wird
$\frac{d\psi x}{du} = \frac{\partial . \int \overline{\varphi x . \partial \psi x}}{\partial t}$
Es sei weiters $fx = \int \overline{\varphi x . \partial \psi x}$ so wird
$\frac{\partial\partial\psi x}{\partial u^2} = \frac{\partial\partial . \int \varphi x^2 . \partial \psi x}{\partial t^2}$ u. allgemein
$\frac{\partial^n . \psi x}{\partial u^n} = \frac{\partial^n . \int \overline{\varphi x^n \partial \psi x}}{\partial t^n} = \frac{\partial^{n-1} . \partial \varphi x^n . \psi' x . \frac{\partial x}{\partial t}}{\partial t^{n-1}}$
Man verlangt nun die Werthe dieser Differentialquotienten für [-...-] den $x = t$. Man hat folglich dafür
$\frac{\partial^{n-1} . \varphi t^n \psi' t}{\partial t^{n-1}}$
